select max(`YEAR_MONTH`) as yearMonth, sum(BASIC_AMOUNT) as basicAmount, sum(POST_AMOUNT) as postAmount, sum(MERIT_AMOUNT) as meritAmount, sum(REAL_MERIT_AMOUNT) as realMeritAmount, sum(REGISTER_AMOUNT) as registerAmount, sum(WORK_AGE_AMOUNT) as workAgeAmount, sum(FULL_AMOUNT) as fullAmount, sum(TEACHER_AMOUNT) as teacherAmount, sum(DUTY_AMOUNT) as dutyAmount, sum(SICK_AMOUNT) as sickAmount, sum(WORK_AMOUNT) as workAmount, sum(LATE_AMOUNT) as lateAmount, sum(MINER_AMOUNT) as minerAmount, sum(MATER_AMOUNT) as materAmount, sum(IN_OUT_AMOUNT) as inOutAmount, sum(ADD_AMOUNT) as addAmount, sum(MINUS_AMOUNT) as minusAmount, sum(GJJ_DIFF_AMOUNT) as gjjDiffAmount, sum(GROSS_PAY_AMOUNT) as grossPayAmount, sum(PER) as per, sum(YN_PER) as ynPer, sum(SY_PER) as syPer, sum(YL_PER) as ylPer, sum(YL_SALE) as ylSale, sum(SYS_PER) as sysPer, sum(TAX_SY) as taxSy, sum(TAX_ZN) as taxZn, sum(TAX_FD) as taxFd, sum(TAX_ZF) as taxZf, sum(TAX_JY) as taxJy, sum(TAX_ZH) as taxZh, sum(EMP_WELFARE_AMOUNT) as empWelfareAmount, sum(OUTER_AMOUNT) as outerAmount, sum(LAST_ADD_AMOUNT) as lastAddAmount, sum(LAST_MINUS_AMOUNT) as lastMinusAmount, sum(TAX_INCOME_AMOUNT) as taxIncomeAmount, sum(LJ_TAX_INCOME_AMOUNT) as ljTaxIncomeAmount, sum(LJ_TAX_AMOUNT) as ljTaxAmount, sum(HAVE_LJ_TAX_AMOUNT) as haveLjTaxAmount, sum(MONTH_TAX_AMOUNT) as monthTaxAmount, sum(IF(REAL_PAY_AMOUNT >= 0,REAL_PAY_AMOUNT,0)) as realPayAmount from HR_SALARY where DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and `YEAR_MONTH`=#{yearMonth}

select max(a.`YEAR_MONTH`) as yearMonth, sum(a.BASIC_AMOUNT) as basicAmount, sum(a.POST_AMOUNT) as postAmount, sum(a.MERIT_AMOUNT) as meritAmount, sum(a.REAL_MERIT_AMOUNT) as realMeritAmount, sum(a.REGISTER_AMOUNT) as registerAmount, sum(a.WORK_AGE_AMOUNT) as workAgeAmount, sum(a.FULL_AMOUNT) as fullAmount, sum(a.TEACHER_AMOUNT) as teacherAmount, sum(a.DUTY_AMOUNT) as dutyAmount, sum(a.SICK_AMOUNT) as sickAmount, sum(a.WORK_AMOUNT) as workAmount, sum(a.LATE_AMOUNT) as lateAmount, sum(a.MINER_AMOUNT) as minerAmount, sum(a.MATER_AMOUNT) as materAmount, sum(a.IN_OUT_AMOUNT) as inOutAmount, sum(a.ADD_AMOUNT) as addAmount, sum(a.MINUS_AMOUNT) as minusAmount, sum(a.GJJ_DIFF_AMOUNT) as gjjDiffAmount, sum(a.GROSS_PAY_AMOUNT) as grossPayAmount, sum(a.PER) as per, sum(a.YN_PER) as ynPer, sum(a.SY_PER) as syPer, sum(a.YL_PER) as ylPer, sum(a.YL_SALE) as ylSale, sum(a.SYS_PER) as sysPer, sum(a.TAX_SY) as taxSy, sum(a.TAX_ZN) as taxZn, sum(a.TAX_FD) as taxFd, sum(a.TAX_ZF) as taxZf, sum(a.TAX_JY) as taxJy, sum(a.TAX_ZH) as taxZh, sum(a.EMP_WELFARE_AMOUNT) as empWelfareAmount, sum(a.OUTER_AMOUNT) as outerAmount, sum(a.LAST_ADD_AMOUNT) as lastAddAmount, sum(a.LAST_MINUS_AMOUNT) as lastMinusAmount, sum(a.TAX_INCOME_AMOUNT) as taxIncomeAmount, sum(a.LJ_TAX_INCOME_AMOUNT) as ljTaxIncomeAmount, sum(a.LJ_TAX_AMOUNT) as ljTaxAmount, sum(a.HAVE_LJ_TAX_AMOUNT) as haveLjTaxAmount, sum(a.MONTH_TAX_AMOUNT) as monthTaxAmount, sum(IF(a.REAL_PAY_AMOUNT >= 0,a.REAL_PAY_AMOUNT,0)) as realPayAmount from HR_SALARY_PREVIEW a left join HR_SALARY b on a.ID = b.PREVIEW_ID and b.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' where a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and a.`YEAR_MONTH`=#{yearMonth} and b.ID is null
